descricao: postos APAC que nao dependem da malha, somados a demanda calculada por hora

colunas.schemaXml: <Field Type='Text' MaxLength='60' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='aeroporto' Name='aeroporto' StaticName='aeroporto' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='60' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='posto' Name='posto' StaticName='posto' Group='AirportNow'/>

<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='20' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='papel' Name='papel' StaticName='papel' Group='AirportNow'><Default>APAC</Default><Validation Message='use APAC ou SUPERVISOR'>=OU([papel]="APAC";[papel]="SUPERVISOR")</Validation></Field>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='hora_inicio' Name='hora_inicio' StaticName='hora_inicio' Group='AirportNow'><Default>0</Default><Validation Message='minutos desde 00:00, de 0 a 1439'>=E([hora_inicio]>=0;[hora_inicio]<=1439)</Validation></Field>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='1' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='hora_fim' Name='hora_fim' StaticName='hora_fim' Group='AirportNow'><Default>1440</Default><Validation Message='minutos desde 00:00, de 1 a 1440'>=E([hora_fim]>=1;[hora_fim]<=1440)</Validation></Field>
<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='quantidade' Name='quantidade' StaticName='quantidade' Group='AirportNow'><Default>1</Default></Field>
<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='ordem' Name='ordem' StaticName='ordem' Group='AirportNow'><Default>0</Default></Field>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='ativo' Name='ativo' StaticName='ativo' Group='AirportNow'><Default>1</Default><Validation Message='use 1 ou 0'>=OU([ativo]=0;[ativo]=1)</Validation></Field>
